# Test decks

Saved by Keynote 15.2.1 and PowerPoint for Mac 16 on macOS, 2026-10-28. Each holds three
figures saved with backstamp, dragged in as PDFs:

| Slide | `*-slides` | `*-reordered` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | nonascii | small |
| 2 | large | nonascii |
| 3 | small | large |
| 4 | all three | all three |
| 5 | all three, resized and moved | all three, resized and moved |

`*-reordered` is the same deck with slide 3 moved to first.

Trimmed to the members backstamp reads:

- `.key`: `Index/Document.iwa`, `Index/Slide*.iwa` and the PDFs under `Data/`
- `.pptx`: `ppt/presentation.xml` and its relationships, `ppt/slides/` and `ppt/media/`
